- A longer description that explains the user request, the implementation details (new constant `CLAUDE_MODEL`, global `claude_mode_enabled`, `build_agent_command`, modifications to `run_opencode` and `main`, and the new test file), and how the existing `wants_resume` parser was reused.
- A section on what worked (tests, lint, pyaot) and what failed (initial docs audit failure that I fixed).

## [2026-06-10 20:55] — claude fable 5 opt-in for ralph sessions

**TL;DR:** ralph.py now starts with a three-gate interactive opt-in (use claude? signed in? sure about Fable 5 cost?); when all answered yes, every agent session runs `claude -p "<prompt>" --model claude-fable-5` instead of opencode. 130 tests pass, lint and pyaot clean.

**Long description:** User request: an interactive prompt in ralph that asks whether to use claude, whether the user is signed in to claude, and an are-you-sure confirmation (it will use Fable 5, very expensive); only when all are agreed should sessions run via `claude -p "[prompt]" --model claude-fable-5`. Implementation in ralph.py: CLAUDE_MODEL = "claude-fable-5" constant and module global claude_mode_enabled (default False); build_agent_command(prompt) returns the claude argv when enabled, else the existing opencode argv; run_opencode now builds its command via build_agent_command, keeping the streaming, logging, and rate-limit termination unchanged for both agents; ask_use_claude() asks the three questions using the existing wants_resume yes-parser (explicit y/yes only, Enter declines) and prints a sign-in hint when the second gate declines; main() sets the global from ask_use_claude() and skips ensure_opencode entirely in claude mode. Sandbox-first: tests/test_ralph_claude_mode.py written before any ralph.py change and seen failing 7/7 (AttributeError on missing functions), passing 7/7 after — covers both argv shapes, the exact CLAUDE_MODEL pin, the all-yes path, and decline at each of the three gates with input-call counts. docs/functions.md gained entries for build_agent_command and ask_use_claude and updated entries for run_opencode and main.

**What worked:** make test 130 passed. make lint exit 0. make pyaot "checked 62 file(s) — 0 error(s)". The wants_resume reuse kept the yes-parsing consistent with the resume prompt.

**What failed:** First make lint failed the docs audit: "missing documentation in docs/functions.md for: ralph.py: function 'ask_use_claude' / 'build_agent_command'" — fixed by adding the entries.

**What was kept / discarded:** Kept everything described. Nothing discarded.

**Open questions / next steps:** Claude mode is untested against a live claude session (costs real Fable 5 usage); the rate-limit regex was built from opencode's 429 output and may not match claude CLI rate-limit phrasing, so a live claude rate limit may surface as a generic failed iteration instead of a handoff. docs/functions.md has pre-existing duplicate ralph.py entries (e.g. run_opencode at two offsets) — out of scope today, flagged for a future docs prune.
